answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one anchor weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 236 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 178 times the capital for one share. The velvet report makes public the merge explicitly at each horizon. Each duplicate costs another 174 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
